 Medium
 Large
 Print Picture Credit: X Prabhas will be seen in the upcoming Hanu Raghavapudi’s period war drama film, ‘Fauzi’. The film was earlier set to release in December however, has been postponed with speculations suggesting a March 2027 release. Now, it has been revealed that the makers will release a short video glimpse of the film on Prabhas’ birthday. The announcement was made at the teaser launch event of ‘Donga Naa Koduku’, starring Mouli Tanuj Prashanth. When Mouli asked Ravi Shankar for an update on ‘Fauzi’, the filmmaker shared details about the upcoming promotional video. Watch Prabhas’ Darling Re-Release Sparks Festive Frenzy, Sets New Pre-Opening Record Over Salaar ‘Fauzi’ glimpse to be released on Prabhas’ birthday
 He said the glimpse would offer audiences an idea of the film’s story and introduce Prabhas’ character. “On the occasion of Prabhas garu’s birthday on October 23, we are going to unveil a small video glimpse. It will tell the story outline of Fauzi and reveal Prabhas’ character, giving his fans and the audience an idea of what the film is about and what they can expect from it,” he said. “It’s not like Baahubali, so don’t go in with expectations like that. You can watch this Fauzi glimpse along with our film 418 in theatres,” he added. Prabhas to play a soldier in ‘Fauzi’
 Talking about ‘Fauzi’, it is a period war drama in which Prabhas is expected to play a soldier. The film marks his return to the period genre after several big-budget projects. The poster released by the makers shows Prabhas covered in blood, sitting on a stone and holding a gun. Its tagline reads, “battalion who fights alone.” The film also stars internet personality Imanvi Esmail, who is making her acting debut, along with Sajjad Delafrooz, Mithun Chakraborty, Anupam Kher and Jaya Prada. Ram Charan-Sukumar film launch update
 During the event, Ravi Shankar also shared an update on his upcoming big-budget film starring Ram Charan and directed by Sukumar. “Sukumar garu is in the UK, and he will return to India in a day or two. The launch will then happen on the 26th or 27th,” he said. Meanwhile, ‘Fauzi’ was earlier expected to release on December 3, 2026, but the film has reportedly been postponed, with March 2027 being discussed as a possible release window. The makers are yet to officially confirm a new theatrical release date.
